zh.title: 打扰阈值
zh.question: 一条提示要有正的期望价值，事后有用概率 p 至少要多高？
zh.assumption: G 与 C 是主观、示意的数值，不是通用部署策略；p 是事后校准的有用率，不是模型自报的置信度。模型只算期望价值，不模拟信任衰减与渠道被静音的非线性后果。
zh.observe: 观察：拖动 p 跨过阈值，看建议如何在“提醒”与“保持沉默”之间翻转？
zh.footerNote: 示意数据 · 模型假设 · 对应来源
zh.referenceTitle: 查看场景与抽样期望值
zh.gainLabel: 一次有用提示的收益 G
zh.costLabel: 一次错误打扰的成本 C

axisLabels.alt: 数轴：标出开口阈值与当前 p 的位置；精确数值见下方读数。

zh.sampleTitle: 抽样期望值（默认场景的 G、C）

explanations.notify: 期望价值为正：在这组 G、C 下，这条提示有理由开口。
explanations.silent: 期望价值为负：错误打扰的成本盖过收益，保持沉默更好。
explanations.equal: 期望价值恰好为 0：开口与沉默等价，这不是默认开口的许可。
explanations.no-preference: G 与 C 同为 0：没有偏好可言，阈值也无从定义。

en.title: Interruption threshold
en.question: How high must the calibrated usefulness p be before a prompt has positive expected value?
en.assumption: G and C are subjective illustrative values, not a universal deployment policy; p is a calibrated past-usefulness rate, not the model's self-reported confidence. The model computes expected value only — it does not simulate trust decay or the nonlinear cost of a muted channel.
en.observe: Observe: drag p across the threshold and watch the advice flip between speak up and stay quiet.
en.referenceTitle: View scenarios and sampled expected values
en.gainLabel: Gain of one useful prompt G
en.costLabel: Cost of one bad interruption C

axisLabels.alt: Number line marking the speak-up threshold and the current p; exact values are in the readout below.

explanations.notify: Expected value is positive: with these G and C, the prompt has a reason to speak.
explanations.silent: Expected value is negative: the bad interruption outweighs the gain — silence is better.
explanations.equal: Expected value is exactly 0: speaking and staying quiet tie — this is not permission to speak by default.
explanations.no-preference: G and C are both 0: there is no preference to express, and the threshold is undefined.
